scope: Cap command result and suppression L1 TTLs so they cannot outlive corresponding SQLite L2 TTLs.
Add deterministic success/failure/suppression L1-over-L2 expiry regressions.
excluded: T06 broker receipt and mutation code

bug_evidence.root_cause: TieredCache checks L1 before L2. CommandBroker configured L1 TTL from l1_ttl_seconds, which can exceed success_ttl_seconds, failure_ttl_seconds or suppression_ttl_seconds; stale L1 entry bypasses expired L2 entry.
bug_evidence.red_result: 3 failed in 0.52s: success result, failure result, and suppression entry stayed live in L1 after configured L2 TTL.
bug_evidence.fix: effective_l1_ttl caps each L1 duration at its persistent cache TTL; TTL zero retains no-expiry semantics and existing 300-second failure/suppression cap.

environment_identity.result: 2 passed in 0.49s with L1/L2 TTL path before latest regression additions
